newsitem.title: MEXICO: Six percent growth for Mexico no pipedream - Ortiz.
newsitem.headline: Six percent growth for Mexico no pipedream - Ortiz.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz said Sunday that he is confident of reaching the government's target of four percent economic growth in 1997 and that sustained growth of six percent a year in following years is not a pipedream.

"Growth will be closer to four percent than to three percent in 1996," Ortiz told a breakfast meeting with international journalists, one day after the government signed a new economic pact for 1997 with labour and business leaders.
